metadata.question: Does the plume from Whakaari/White Island, New Zealand travel in a southern direction on January 7, 2025?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Location: Whakaari/White Island, New Zealand (~37.52°S, 177.18°E) - Date: January 7, 2025 - Collection: Sentinel-2 or Landsat for visible imagery to see volcanic plume - Need to visualize or analyze the plume direction 2. Masking strategy: - NO cloud masking - we want to see the plume which appears as clouds/aerosols - The plume itself is what we're looking for 3. Logic: - Get imagery from Jan 7, 2025 - Analyze the plume direction by sampling pixels south of the volcano - Compare aerosol/reflectance values directly south vs other directions - Valid result: A (yes, southward) or B (no, not southward) - C1: No images available - C2: Not applicable (we need the plume pixels) - C3: Calculation fails or unclear result ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // Whakaari/White Island coordinates const volcano = ee.Geometry.Point([177.18, -37.52]); // Define regions to check plume direction const southRegion = ee.Geometry.Point([177.18, -37.62]); // 10km south const northRegion = ee.Geometry.Point([177.18, -37.42]); // 10km north const eastRegion = ee.Geometry.Point([177.28, -37.52]); // 10km east const westRegion = ee.Geometry.Point([177.08, -37.52]); // 10km west // Search for Sentinel-2 imagery on January 7, 2025 let collection = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_HARMONIZED') .filterBounds(volcano) .filterDate('2025-01-07', '2025-01-08') .sort('CLOUDY_PIXEL_PERCENTAGE'); let size = collection.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Sentinel-2 images found: ${size}`); // Fallback to Landsat if no Sentinel-2 if (size === 0) { collection = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC09/C02/T1_L2') .filterBounds(volcano) .filterDate('2025-01-07', '2025-01-08'); size = collection.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Landsat-9 images found: ${size}`); } if (size === 0) { console.log('No images available for January 7, 2025'); console.log('C1'); return; } // Get the first (least cloudy) image const image = collection.first(); // Use aerosol band (B1 for Sentinel-2) or TrueColor composite let aerosolBand = image.select(['B1', 'B2', 'B4'], ['aerosol', 'blue', 'red']); // Sample aerosol values in each direction const southVal = aerosolBand.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: southRegion.buffer(2000), scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('aerosol').getInfo(); const northVal = aerosolBand.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: northRegion.buffer(2000), scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('aerosol').getInfo(); const eastVal = aerosolBand.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: eastRegion.buffer(2000), scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('aerosol').getInfo(); const westVal = aerosolBand.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: westRegion.buffer(2000), scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('aerosol').getInfo(); console.log(`Aerosol values - South: ${southVal}, North: ${northVal}, East: ${eastVal}, West: ${westVal}`); if (southVal === null || southVal === undefined) { console.log('Failed to calculate aerosol values'); console.log('C3'); return; } // Check if plume travels south (higher aerosol values to the south) const maxOther = Math.max(northVal || 0, eastVal || 0, westVal || 0); console.log(`Max aerosol in other directions: ${maxOther}`); console.log(`South aerosol ratio: ${(southVal / maxOther).toFixed(2)}`); // Plume travels south if southern values significantly higher if (southVal > maxOther * 1.2) { console.log('Plume direction: SOUTH'); console.log('A'); } else { console.log('Plume direction: NOT primarily south'); console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
